claim: AM par Alexandre Mazzia is a Three Stars: Exceptional cuisine restaurant in the 2026 MICHELIN Guide France, at 9 Rue Francois Rocca, 13008 Marseille.
quote: AM par Alexandre Mazzia ... Three Stars: Exceptional cuisine

claim: Chef Alexandre Mazzia, a basketball player turned chef, earned his third star in 2021; a la carte runs roughly 195-435 euro and reservations are by phone +33 4 91 24 83 63.

quote: Maldorme Menu: 230 ... My Bouille Abaisse: 390 ... Sea Discovery Menu: 490 ... needs 48-hour booking

claim: Le Petit Nice holds 3 Michelin Stars in 2026, with average price around 290 euro and bookings by phone +33 4 91 592 592 or email contact@passedat.fr.
quote: Le Petit Nice Restaurant holds 3 Michelin Stars ... average price ... around 290

claim: Une Table au Sud holds one Michelin star under chef Ludovic Turac, serving Marseille/Mediterranean cuisine at 2 Quai du Port overlooking the Vieux Port, lunch from ~95 euro and dinner menus 135-175 euro, reservations +33 4 91 90 63 53.
quote: Ludovic Turac ... dinner menus range from 135 to 175, with a lunch menu at 95

claim: L'Epuisette is a one-star restaurant (its star held for over two decades) under chef Guillaume Sourrieu, perched at the mouth of Port du Vallon des Auffes, with seafood/bouillabaisse menus named Fanny, Marius and Cesar (Fanny menu ~135 euro), phone +33 4 91 52 17 82.
quote: menus, named Fanny, Marius and Cesar ... at the mouth of the entrance to the Port du Vallon des Auffes

claim: Auffo, chef Coline Faulquier, won its first Michelin star on 16 March 2026, serving lively Mediterranean cuisine with a strong vegetable component at 158 rue du Vallon des Auffes, 13007 Marseille; Faulquier is Marseille's sole female starred chef.
quote: premiere etoile Michelin ... le 16 mars 2026 ... l'unique cheffe etoilee de Marseille

claim: Coline Faulquier closed her one-star restaurant Signature (opened 2019, starred 2021) in early 2025 to focus on her new venture Auffo, so Signature no longer operates.
quote: Coline Faulquier closed her previous restaurant, Signature, in early 2025 to dedicate herself entirely to her new venture, Auffo
